items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: No daily drawdown cap. Losses are not evaluated on a per-day basis.

items.label: Max Overall Loss
items.detail: Intraday trailing drawdown based on equity High Water Mark. Trails up as equity grows. Locks at initial balance once 7% profit is reached. Example: $10k account → floor starts at $9,300, rises as HWM rises, locks at $10,000 once balance exceeds $10,700.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Single phase. 7% of initial balance required to pass. No minimum trading days.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: No minimum or maximum trading days required.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Max 2% of initial balance per trade idea (funded only). Correlated assets = 1 idea. New trade within 10 min of close = same idea. SL required within 3 min of opening. Violation = instant termination. Effective 7 Apr 2026.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No new trade in 30 consecutive days = permanent suspension.

items.label: Time Limit
items.detail: No maximum time to complete the challenge.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No restrictions on high-impact news in challenge or funded account.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: Positions may remain open over the weekend in challenge and funded.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on overnight positions in any phase.

items.label: Bi-Weekly
items.detail: Min 3 profitable days in 14 days. A profitable day = net closed profit ≥ 0.5% of initial balance.

items.label: Monthly
items.detail: Min 7 profitable days in 30 days. Same profitable-day definition applies.

rows: Bank Wire / Crypto (BTC, USDC, ETH, USDT)

items.label: Refund
items.detail: 25% returned with each of the first 4 payouts. Example: $709 fee → $177.25 per payout.

items.label: Swap-Free
items.detail: Example: $709 → $779.90. Must be selected at purchase.

items.label: Reset
items.detail: Example: $709 → $921.70. Issues a new challenge from scratch. One use only. Not available for funded stage.

items.label: Max Total Funded
items.detail: Combined cap across all active funded accounts (challenges + direct).

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Only One Challenge funded accounts can be merged together. No open trades and not mid-payout-cycle required.

items.label: Platforms
items.value: DX Trade, MT4, MT5, Match Trader, Trade-Locker, CTrader
